faqs.question: Which of these love stories takes place on 31 October itself?
faqs.answer: Hubie Halloween (2020) plays out almost entirely over one 31 October in Salem, with a slow-burn romance running under the comedy. Meet Me in St. Louis (1944) has a Halloween chapter, but it is one of four seasons.

faqs.question: Are there romantic Halloween movies that aren't scary at all?
faqs.answer: Yes. Teen Witch, Just Like Heaven, I Married a Witch and Meet Me in St. Louis have no real scares, whatever their ratings say. Lisa Frankenstein and The Shape of Water are the two to avoid if you dislike bloody images.

faqs.question: Is The Shape of Water OK to watch with teenagers?
faqs.answer: The MPA rated it R for sexual content, graphic nudity, violence and language, so it is an adults' film. For a teenager who wants a monster romance, Love at First Bite is rated PG.

faqs.question: Why can't I stream Truly Madly Deeply anywhere?
faqs.answer: On 13 October 2026 JustWatch listed it only as a rental, on Amazon in the US and Apple TV in the UK, with no page at all for Canada, Australia or India. Check again nearer Halloween, because older British films move between services often.

faqs.question: Which of these films can I stream in India?
faqs.answer: On 13 October 2026: Ghost on JioHotstar, Teen Witch on Prime Video, Beautiful Creatures through a Lionsgate Play channel on Prime Video, and Hubie Halloween on Netflix. Most of the others were rental-only or not listed.

faqs.question: Why don't older films like I Married a Witch have an MPA rating?
faqs.answer: A search of the MPA's filmratings.com database on 13 October 2026 returned no record for I Married a Witch, Truly Madly Deeply or Meet Me in St. Louis. Use the badge your streaming app shows instead, and say which badge you are reading.

faqs.question: Is Lisa Frankenstein a horror movie or a romcom?
faqs.answer: It is a dark romantic comedy about a teenager and a revived Victorian corpse. Its PG-13 carries seven descriptors, including bloody images and sexual assault, so read them before choosing it for a mixed group.

faqs.question: Does watching a romantic movie together actually help a relationship?
faqs.answer: One three-year trial of 174 couples found 24% of couples with no programme had split up, against 11% across three programmes, one of them a single session with no skills training. The lead researcher describes that light programme as couples discussing movies about relationships.

faqs.question: Will these films be on the same services for Halloween 2027?
faqs.answer: Probably not all of them. Every streaming line here is a 13 October 2026 snapshot; recheck JustWatch for your country before 31 October 2027, which is a Sunday.

faqs.question: What can I send my partner after a romantic Halloween movie?
faqs.answer: A personalised Halloween page works if they are not in the room: the regular card takes about five minutes and holds six photos, the premium page about ten minutes with a 60-second voice note. If you are on the same sofa, skip the link.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Romantic Halloween Movies, Grouped by What Kind of Love Story

The romantic Halloween movies worth your 31 October come in four kinds of love story: a ghost who will not leave, a witch whose spell goes sideways, a monster who turns out to be the catch, and a romance that peaks on Halloween night. Below are 11 films across those four, each with its year, its rating from the Motion Picture Association's own database, and where it streamed in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and India on 13 October 2026. If the night ends with a message, plan it for a phone: on SubhSandesh, 48.3% of shared pages are opened on a phone, and the average page is viewed 11.1 times. Then come a ratings table, one study on talking over a film, and when this list is wrong.

## What counts as a romantic Halloween movie?

A romantic Halloween movie is a film where the love story is the main plot and the supernatural, the spooky or the 31 October setting shapes it. A horror film with a couple in it does not qualify; a romcom with a ghost does.

Ratings run from PG for a 1979 vampire spoof to R for a 2017 creature romance. We checked every rating on [the MPA's film ratings search](https://www.filmratings.com/search-results/?search=lisa+frankenstein) on 13 October 2026, and three of the older titles have no MPA record at all.

## 11 romantic Halloween movies, by type of love story

Each film gets the same four lines: story, MPA rating, where it streamed on 13 October 2026, and who it suits. Streaming homes come from [JustWatch's per-country title pages](https://www.justwatch.com/us/movie/ghost) and count services that include the film in a plan or with ads, not rentals.

### 1. Ghost (1990): ghost love

- **Story:** a murdered New York banker stays on as a spirit to protect his partner, and a reluctant psychic becomes his only voice.
- **MPA:** PG-13, certificate 30013.
- **Streaming:** Paramount+ and MGM+ in the US; Paramount+ in Canada; Stan, Binge and Foxtel Now in Australia; JioHotstar in India. Rental only in the UK.
- **Suits:** two people who want one proper cry before the doorbell stops ringing.

### 2. Truly Madly Deeply (1991): ghost love

- **Story:** a London interpreter, flattened by grief for her cellist partner, finds him back in her flat with dead friends who make terrible housemates.
- **MPA:** no record in the MPA search; JustWatch shows a PG badge in the US and UK.
- **Streaming:** rental only, on Amazon in the US and Apple TV in the UK; no JustWatch page for Canada, Australia or India.
- **Suits:** anyone who has lost someone. A [2021 BJPsych Open survey of 1,004 bereaved people](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC8388006) found that sensing a dead loved one is common and usually comforting, which is roughly this film's argument.

### 3. Just Like Heaven (2005): ghost love

- **Story:** a workaholic San Francisco doctor appears as a spirit in her old apartment, and the grieving man who has sublet it is the sole person able to see her.
- **MPA:** PG-13 for some sexual content, certificate 41875.
- **Streaming:** Hoopla (library card) and ad-supported YouTube in the US; Paramount+ in the UK; a StackTV channel on Prime Video in Canada. Rental only in Australia and India.
- **Suits:** the lightest of the three ghost films.

### 4. I Married a Witch (1942): witch romance

- **Story:** a witch burned in Puritan New England returns centuries later to ruin the descendant of her accuser, and her love potion lands on the wrong person.
- **MPA:** no record in the MPA search.
- **Streaming:** the Criterion Channel and HBO Max in the US; the Criterion Channel in Canada; only the niche service Artiflix in the UK, Australia and India.
- **Suits:** couples who like black-and-white comedy.

### 5. Teen Witch (1989): witch romance

- **Story:** an awkward teenager learns on her 16th birthday that she has powers, uses them to win the most popular boy in school, then works out that the spell is the problem.
- **MPA:** PG-13, certificate 29582.
- **Streaming:** Prime Video in all five regions; the US adds Kanopy, Hoopla and ad-supported Tubi and The Roku Channel.
- **Suits:** a camp, nostalgic night, and the easiest film here to find anywhere.

### 6. Beautiful Creatures (2013): witch romance

- **Story:** a South Carolina teenager falls for the new girl, a "caster" whose powers will be claimed for light or dark when she turns 16.
- **MPA:** PG-13 for violence, scary images and some sexual material, certificate 48072.
- **Streaming:** Prime Video in the UK and Australia; a Lionsgate Play channel on Prime Video in India; ad-supported Tubi in the US and Canada.
- **Suits:** young-adult fantasy fans who would rather see a spell than a jump scare.

### 7. Love at First Bite (1979): monster romcom

- **Story:** Count Dracula, evicted from his castle, lands in disco-era New York and falls for a fashion model whose psychiatrist boyfriend descends from Van Helsing.
- **MPA:** PG, certificate 25435.
- **Streaming:** Prime Video in the UK; no streaming offer in the US and no JustWatch page for Canada, Australia or India.
- **Suits:** a silly spoof.

### 8. Lisa Frankenstein (2024): monster romcom

- **Story:** in 1989, a lonely teenager accidentally revives the Victorian corpse she has been visiting at the cemetery and helps him rebuild himself.
- **MPA:** PG-13 for violent content, bloody images, sexual material, language, sexual assault, teen drinking and drug content, certificate 54044, the longest descriptor list here.
- **Streaming:** Peacock in the US; Netflix in Canada. Rental only in the UK and Australia; nothing listed for India.
- **Suits:** couples who like their comedy dark.

### 9. The Shape of Water (2017): monster romcom

- **Story:** a mute cleaner at a 1962 Baltimore government laboratory falls in love with the amphibian creature held captive there.
- **MPA:** R for sexual content, graphic nudity, violence and language, certificate 51030.
- **Streaming:** HBO Max in the US; Prime Video in the UK; Disney+ and Crave in Canada. Nothing listed for Australia or India.
- **Suits:** adults only; the most serious film here.

### 10. Meet Me in St. Louis (1944): Halloween-night romance

- **Story:** a St. Louis family's year before the 1904 World's Fair, in four seasonal chapters; the autumn chapter's night of bonfires and dares ends with the main couple back on track.
- **MPA:** no record in the MPA search.
- **Streaming:** Kanopy plus ad-supported Tubi, Plex and Philo in the US; ad-supported Tubi in Canada. Rental only in the UK, Australia and India.
- **Suits:** musical fans; skip to the Halloween chapter for the spooky part.

### 11. Hubie Halloween (2020): Halloween-night romance

- **Story:** a jittery volunteer who guards Salem's Halloween night chases a string of disappearances while the neighbour he has adored since school starts to notice him.
- **MPA:** PG-13 for crude and suggestive content, language and brief teen partying, certificate 52820.
- **Streaming:** Netflix in all five regions.
- **Suits:** the one film here set almost entirely on 31 October.

## Ratings and streaming by type of love story

The table groups the 11 films by romance type and counts how many of the five regions had a streaming home for each on 13 October 2026.

| Love story | Films | MPA ratings | Regions with a streaming home |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ghost love | Ghost, Truly Madly Deeply, Just Like Heaven | PG-13, none, PG-13 | 4, 0, 3 of 5 |
| Witch romance | I Married a Witch, Teen Witch, Beautiful Creatures | none, PG-13, PG-13 | 5, 5, 5 of 5 |
| Monster romcom | Love at First Bite, Lisa Frankenstein, The Shape of Water | PG, PG-13, R | 1, 2, 3 of 5 |
| Halloween-night romance | Meet Me in St. Louis, Hubie Halloween | none, PG-13 | 2, 5 of 5 |

The witch films travel best and the monster romcoms worst. Streaming deals turn over constantly, so treat each row as a 13 October 2026 snapshot and recheck before Halloween 2027, which falls on a Sunday.

## Talk about the film afterwards: what a 3-year study found

In a [2013 Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology trial](https://europepmc.org/article/MED/24060193) of 174 engaged and newlywed couples, 24% of couples given no programme had split up three years later, against 11% across the three programmes tested, one of them a single session with no skills training. We read the abstract only.

That light programme is the one built on films. The [lead researcher's University of Rochester faculty page](https://www.sas.rochester.edu/psy/people/faculty/rogge_ronald/index.html) describes couples using movies and TV shows to ease into discussing their own relationship, and says it roughly halved the divorce rate over the early years of marriage. Ghost love and witch romance hand you easy openers.

## Sending a Halloween page after the credits

The [interactive Halloween card with a jack-o'-lantern and a flashlight letter](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) takes about five minutes, holds up to six photos and ends by asking whether they will be your boo. Pick it for a same-evening gesture.

The [cinematic Halloween page with a voice note and an unlock time](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) takes about ten minutes. It holds up to 12 photos, a voice note of up to 60 seconds and a reply box, and the unlock time can keep it sealed until the credits roll.

Watching the same film in two cities? A [page built for missing someone far away](https://subhsandesh.in/missyou-gf) fits better. Its senders password-protect it 43.5% of the time, against 38.5% platform-wide, though it went live only on 28 July 2026 and the sample is 214 pages.

## When a romantic Halloween movie is the wrong pick

Skip The Shape of Water and Lisa Frankenstein with younger teenagers or anyone who hates bloody images; their MPA descriptors are explicit for a reason. If your partner wants real fear, pick a horror double bill instead.

The Halloween page adds little in two cases. On the same sofa, holding hands needs no link. And since 48.3% of SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone, someone who lives on a desktop or rarely checks messages would rather find a handwritten note on the remote. The pages are in English only.

auditReport.honestAssessment: The two analysed ranking pages are 2017 and 2019 lists with no ratings, no availability and no grouping; this post adds MPA certificates, a dated five-country streaming check and a romance-type taxonomy, which an answer engine can lift for 'where can I stream X' and 'is X OK for teens' sub-queries. It cannot overcome the domain-authority gap with editorial film sites, and the streaming lines go stale within months, so the post needs a recheck before Halloween 2027.
